release_notes: The traffic source's S2S postback now reaches the campaign, Keitaro-style. Picking a source that has a postback URL seeds the campaign's S2S Postbacks automatically (when the list is empty); for campaigns configured earlier, the S2S tab shows a one-click hint that adds the source's postback with its own statuses - switching sources never duplicates rows. Together with v1.5.11's status aliases (approved -> sale out of the box) this closes the loop for networks like BIGO: if your campaign's S2S filter was tuned to the old 'custom' status, tick the sale chip in the campaign's S2S Postbacks tab - the built-in postback tester will confirm it instantly.
